items.title: Brazil release notes: product features and changes
items.summary: The current official release-notes index is for Brazil and links product-specific changes, including AI experiences, AI Agent Studio, AI Control Tower, App Engine, Integration Hub, CSM, HR Service Delivery, ITSM, ITOM, Security Operations and other product families. Open the relevant product page for details and availability.

items.title: October model changes: new models, retirements and replacements
items.summary: The October 2026 update adds Gemma 4 26B-A4B for large and small use cases and Gemini 3.7 Flash for Build Agent only. Gemini 2.5 models and Claude Sonnet 4.5 were retired on October 8; Gemini 3.5 Flash and Claude Sonnet 4.6 are their replacements. ServiceNow V2 language models are deprecated for new development, with retirement planned for December. Verify your instance and configuration against the full notes.

items.title: Build Agent October release adds model and playbook support
items.summary: The October 2026 Build Agent notes list Google Gemini 3.7 Flash support, additional metadata support for assessments, database views and sys wizard answers, regulated-market support for the ServiceNow Protected Platform, and expanded playbook capabilities. The full version history includes the detailed changes and compatibility information.
